title: Patch: Back closes the Marketplace and the deck builder's history, cosmetics and portrait pickers
thread: **Issue #2604 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #2604: Patch: Back closes the Marketplace and the deck builder's history, cosmetics and portrait pickers Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means On a phone, the back gesture closes whatever panel you opened last, such as a card, the settings or the chat. Four panels were missed: the Marketplace in a match, and the deck builder's deck history, deck cosmetics and portrait picker. Today, with the Marketplace open in an online match, Back asks whether you want to leave the match. On the deck builder, Back leaves the page. Once this is built, one Back closes the panel, as Escape already does. ## Why - R2127000 lists the overlays that Back closes. #2563 added the Collection's card view and the statistics breakdown to it. The four panels below are not on the list. - `apps/web/src/game/Marketplace.tsx:105-141` closes only on Escape (`setOpen(false)`) and has no `useBackLayer`. - `game/deckbuilder/DeckHistory.tsx:113-120`, `DeckCosmeticsPicker.tsx:47-54` and `emotes/PortraitPicker.tsx:97-111` close on Escape and on a press outside the panel, but not on Back. - These siblings already close on Back through `useBackLayer`: `settings/SettingsPanel.tsx:138`, `together/ChatPanel.tsx:69`, `collection/CardCosmeticsView.tsx:282`, `routes/stats.tsx:199` and `game/ConfirmConcede.tsx:35`. ## Proposal Each of the four panels calls `useBackLayer(close)` while it is open, and closes through its own close function so the focus goes back as it does on Escape. R2127000's "Which" paragraph names them, edited in the same pull request and citing the issue. ## Where it lands - `apps/web/src/game/Marketplace.tsx` - `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckHistory.tsx` and `DeckCosmeticsPicker.tsx` - `apps/web/src/emotes/PortraitPicker.tsx` - their test files - `spec/rulings/R2127000.md` (SPEC §10.10) ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] With the Marketplace open in a live match, one Back closes it and the address stays. The leave guard (R1754000) is not asked, and a second Back meets the guard as before. - [ ] On `/decks`, one Back closes each of the three deck-builder panels and the page stays on `/decks`. - [ ] Escape still closes each panel exactly once, with nothing under it closed too. - [ ] R2127000 names the four panels and lists the new test files in `proven_in`, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes. ## Size and risks Small to medium, about 8 files, following an existing pattern. The one risk is the Marketplace being open when a prompt opens. A prompt is never a layer, so the stack's order handles that case. A test should cover it. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `claude-3` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41236626351)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ I've read the four panels, `backLayers.ts`, the tests that already exist and #2563's earlier edit to R2127000. The plan is ready. ## Goal Back closes four panels that currently miss it, the same way Escape closes them: the Marketplace's shop in a match, and the deck builder's history, cosmetics and portrait pickers. One Back closes the open panel and the address stays. In a live match the leave guard (R1754000) is not asked, and the next Back meets it as before. If a prompt is drawn over the open shop, Back closes the shop and the prompt stays unanswered. Escape still closes each panel once. R2127000 names the four panels and lists the new tests in `proven_in`, and `spec check` passes. ## Files to touch | Path | Kind | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/net/backLayers.ts` | change | new export `BackLayer({ onClose })`, a component that renders nothing and calls `useBackLayer` | | `apps/web/src/game/Marketplace.tsx` | change | `toggle` and `panel` refs, a `close` callback used by Escape and Back, `` inside the open panel | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckHistory.tsx` | change | `` inside the open panel | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckCosmeticsPicker.tsx` | change | `` inside the open panel | | `apps/web/src/emotes/PortraitPicker.tsx` | change | Escape's body moved into a `closeMenu` callback, `` inside the open menu | | `apps/web/src/game/Marketplace.test.tsx` | change | new `describe` with three R2127000 tests | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckWorkshop.test.tsx` | change | new `describe` with two R2127000 tests | | `apps/web/src/emotes/PortraitPicker.test.tsx` | change | new `describe` with one R2127000 test | | `spec/rulings/R2127000.md` | change | `cards`, `proven_in`, the **Which**, **Never by Back** and **Rejected** paragraphs | | `apps/web/README.md` | change | the "**Back closes the top overlay**" paragraph (line 99) names the new users | Do not touch `apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx` (leave its `DrillDownBackLayer` as it is), `navigate.ts`, any crate, `spec/11-rulings.md` or `spec/INDEX.md`. Do not create `spec/pending/`: this edits an existing ruling and adds no new one, as #2563 did. Do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`. The spec that governs this is SPEC §10.10 (line 280 of `spec/10-engine-guide.md`, which stays unchanged), R2127000 and R1754000. It also cites R1853003, R2100000, R1297000 and R641. ## Steps 1. **`apps/web/src/net/backLayers.ts`**: after `useBackLayer` (end of file), add: ```ts /** * R2127000: `useBackLayer` as an element, for an overlay drawn inline while its own state says it is * open: mounted with the overlay, it is a layer exactly while the overlay shows, and with it shut Back * leaves the screen as before. */ export function BackLayer({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }): null { useBackLayer(onClose); return null; } ``` 2. **`apps/web/src/game/Marketplace.tsx`**, in the default export `Marketplace`: - Change the react import to `useCallback, useId, useRef, useState, type ReactElement`. Add `import { BackLayer } from "../net/backLayers.ts";` after the `../i18n/i18n.ts` import. - After `const panelId = useId();` and **before** `const market = view.marketplace;` (hooks must come before the early `return null`), add: ```ts const toggle = useRef(null); const panel = useRef(null); // Escape and Back (R2127000) close the shop and give the focus back to its toggle, unless the // player put it elsewhere (a prompt drawn over the shop keeps it), as the portrait picker does (#1569). const close = useCallback((): void => { const focused = document.activeElement; const inside = focused === null || focused === document.body || panel.current?.contains(focused) === true; setOpen(false); if (inside) toggle.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, []); ``` - On the toggle `

````markdown
# Plan (opus, strong)

I've read the four panels, `backLayers.ts`, the tests that already exist and #2563's earlier edit to R2127000. The plan is ready.

<!-- bot: {"difficulty": "medium", "why": "rule line 3 fails: the change edits spec/rulings/R2127000.md (its Which paragraph, cards and proven_in), so it touches a hot spot even though it adds no new ruling; the other lines hold (about 10 files, all in apps/web, unit tests only)"} -->

## Goal

Back closes four panels that currently miss it, the same way Escape closes them: the Marketplace's shop in a match, and the deck builder's history, cosmetics and portrait pickers. One Back closes the open panel and the address stays. In a live match the leave guard (R1754000) is not asked, and the next Back meets it as before. If a prompt is drawn over the open shop, Back closes the shop and the prompt stays unanswered. Escape still closes each panel once. R2127000 names the four panels and lists the new tests in `proven_in`, and `spec check` passes.

## Files to touch

| Path | Kind | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/net/backLayers.ts` | change | new export `BackLayer({ onClose })`, a component that renders nothing and calls `useBackLayer` |
| `apps/web/src/game/Marketplace.tsx` | change | `toggle` and `panel` refs, a `close` callback used by Escape and Back, `<BackLayer>` inside the open panel |
| `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckHistory.tsx` | change | `<BackLayer onClose={close} />` inside the open panel |
| `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckCosmeticsPicker.tsx` | change | `<BackLayer onClose={close} />` inside the open panel |
| `apps/web/src/emotes/PortraitPicker.tsx` | change | Escape's body moved into a `closeMenu` callback, `<BackLayer onClose={closeMenu} />` inside the open menu |
| `apps/web/src/game/Marketplace.test.tsx` | change | new `describe` with three R2127000 tests |
| `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckWorkshop.test.tsx` | change | new `describe` with two R2127000 tests |
| `apps/web/src/emotes/PortraitPicker.test.tsx` | change | new `describe` with one R2127000 test |
| `spec/rulings/R2127000.md` | change | `cards`, `proven_in`, the **Which**, **Never by Back** and **Rejected** paragraphs |
| `apps/web/README.md` | change | the "**Back closes the top overlay**" paragraph (line 99) names the new users |

Do not touch `apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx` (leave its `DrillDownBackLayer` as it is), `navigate.ts`, any crate, `spec/11-rulings.md` or `spec/INDEX.md`. Do not create `spec/pending/`: this edits an existing ruling and adds no new one, as #2563 did. Do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`.

The spec that governs this is SPEC §10.10 (line 280 of `spec/10-engine-guide.md`, which stays unchanged), R2127000 and R1754000. It also cites R1853003, R2100000, R1297000 and R641.

## Steps

1. **`apps/web/src/net/backLayers.ts`**: after `useBackLayer` (end of file), add:
   ```ts
   /**
    * R2127000: `useBackLayer` as an element, for an overlay drawn inline while its own state says it is
    * open: mounted with the overlay, it is a layer exactly while the overlay shows, and with it shut Back
    * leaves the screen as before.
    */
   export function BackLayer({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }): null {
     useBackLayer(onClose);
     return null;
   }
   ```

2. **`apps/web/src/game/Marketplace.tsx`**, in the default export `Marketplace`:
   - Change the react import to `useCallback, useId, useRef, useState, type ReactElement`. Add `import { BackLayer } from "../net/backLayers.ts";` after the `../i18n/i18n.ts` import.
   - After `const panelId = useId();` and **before** `const market = view.marketplace;` (hooks must come before the early `return null`), add:
     ```ts
     const toggle = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
     const panel = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
     // Escape and Back (R2127000) close the shop and give the focus back to its toggle, unless the
     // player put it elsewhere (a prompt drawn over the shop keeps it), as the portrait picker does (#1569).
     const close = useCallback((): void => {
       const focused = document.activeElement;
       const inside = focused === null || focused === document.body || panel.current?.contains(focused) === true;
       setOpen(false);
       if (inside) toggle.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
     }, []);
     ```
   - On the toggle `<button>`, add `ref={toggle}`. Its `onClick` stays as it is.
   - On the `<section className="marketplace-panel">`, add `ref={panel}` and change `onKeyDown` to `if (event.key === "Escape") close();`.
   - Put `<BackLayer onClose={close} />` as the section's first child, before `<header>`.
   - In the header comment, after the sentence "A toggle opens a panel…", add: `Escape and Back (R2127000) close it.`

3. **`apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckHistory.tsx`**: add `import { BackLayer } from "../../net/backLayers.ts";` after the i18n import. Put `<BackLayer onClose={close} />` as the first child of the `<div className="ws-cosmetics-panel ws-versions-panel" …>`. Change the comment `// Outside press and Escape close the panel, like the cosmetics picker's.` to `// Outside press and Escape close the panel, like the cosmetics picker's; Back does too (R2127000, the panel's BackLayer).`

4. **`apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckCosmeticsPicker.tsx`**: the same import (`../../net/backLayers.ts`), `<BackLayer onClose={close} />` as the first child of `<div className="ws-cosmetics-panel" role="dialog" …>`, before the `{/* R1297000 … */}` comment. Add the same `; Back does too (R2127000, the panel's BackLayer).` to the "Outside press and Escape close the picker" comment.

5. **`apps/web/src/emotes/PortraitPicker.tsx`**, in `PortraitPicker`:
   - Add `import { BackLayer } from "../net/backLayers.ts";`, placed in alphabetical order among the `../` imports (after `../cards/chinese.ts`, before `../i18n/i18n.ts`).
   - Before the outside-press/Escape `useEffect`, add:
     ```ts
     // Escape and Back (R2127000) give the focus back to the portrait button unless the player has put
     // it elsewhere on the page (#1569).
     const closeMenu = useCallback((): void => {
       setOpen(false);
       const focused = document.activeElement;
       if (focused === null || focused === document.body || root.current?.contains(focused) === true) {
         toggle.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
       }
     }, []);
     ```
   - In that effect, make `onKeyDown` `if (event.key !== "Escape") return; closeMenu();` and change the deps to `[open, closeMenu]`. Trim the existing comment's Escape-focus sentence, which now sits on `closeMenu`.
   - Put `<BackLayer onClose={closeMenu} />` as the first child of `<div className="portrait-menu" …>`.

6. **`spec/rulings/R2127000.md`**:
   - `cards:` becomes `"§10.10, §10.6, R313, R370, R641, R654, R1297000, R1655000, R1754000, R1853003, R2100000, R2117000, R2118000, R2121000, issue #2036, issue #2127, issue #2563, issue #2604"`.
   - Append to `proven_in`: `apps/web/src/game/Marketplace.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckWorkshop.test.tsx` and `apps/web/src/emotes/PortraitPicker.test.tsx`.
   - In **Which**, after `…([[R654]]), both since issue #2563;` insert ` the Marketplace's shop in a match ([[R1853003]]) and the deck builder's history ([[R2100000]]), cosmetics ([[R1297000]]) and portrait picker ([[R641]]), all since issue #2604;`. Rewrap the paragraph to about 100 columns.
   - In **Never by Back**, after "With one of them on top Back works as it did, and it leaves the screen." add: `An overlay left open under one is still a layer, so Back closes it first and the choice stays unanswered: the Marketplace's shop with a prompt drawn over it (issue #2604).`
   - In **Rejected**, before the final full stop, add `; for the Marketplace, giving the focus back to its toggle on every close, which would pull it out of a prompt drawn over the shop`.
````
